papers.title: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
papers.abstract: Robotic foundation models are typically evaluated through costly closed-loop rollouts, which motivates cheap offline proxies for model capability. The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) suggests that as representations improve, different modalities such as vision and language converge toward a shared statistical model of reality. We ask whether motion trajectories form another such modality: as embodied models become more capable, should their sensory representations converge toward the structure of physical motion? To examine this, we propose Sensorimotor Alignment ($S^2$), a training-free offline metric that measures how well a model's sensory representation aligns with the geometry of physical motion. We find that $S^2$ correlates positively with downstream robot task success across embodied model families, making it a low-cost offline proxy for prioritizing models before closed-loop evaluation. $S^2$ can also identify promising vision-language model (VLM) backbones even before costly fine-tuning into vision-language-action models (VLAs). Beyond this correlation, $S^2$ offers representation-level explanations for phenomena observed in VLAs and world action models (WAMs). With $S^2$, we extend PRH to embodied models and make sensorimotor alignment empirically measurable, offering insight into why an embodied model succeeds beyond its closed-loop success rate.

ai_summary.problem: 机器人基础模型通常依赖昂贵的闭环 rollout 评估，亟需低成本的离线代理指标来预测具身策略成功与否，并检验柏拉图表示假设是否可扩展到运动轨迹模态。
ai_summary.method: 提出 Sensorimotor Alignment（S²），一种无需训练的离线指标，衡量模型感官表示与物理运动几何结构之间的对齐程度，并用于跨具身模型家族的模型排序与 VLM 骨干筛选。
ai_summary.result: S² 与下游机器人任务成功率呈正相关，可作为闭环评估前的低成本代理；还能在 VLA 微调前识别有潜力的 VLM 骨干，并为 VLA/WAM 中的现象提供表示层面解释。
ai_summary.novelty: 将柏拉图表示假设扩展到具身模型，并把感官-运动对齐变成可经验测量的离线代理指标。
ai_summary.relevance: 为具身智能模型提供低成本评估与选择工具，并从表示层理解具身策略成功的原因。

papers.title: Reading, Writing, Sharing, and Interacting with the World through Video
papers.abstract: Video foundation models have advanced rapidly in understanding and generating visual sequences, while video world models seek to capture the underlying dynamics of the world they depict. Despite their different objectives, both concern the relationship between video observations and an evolving world. This survey adopts world modeling as a unifying lens for examining these developments. Viewing an observed video as a partial, lossy, and temporally ordered projection of a latent temporal world, we organize the literature around four complementary operations: reading infers world properties from observed video; writing synthesizes video from specified or learned world conditions; sharing integrates understanding and generation through common modeling mechanisms; and interacting predicts and updates world states under actions and evolving observations. This perspective distinguishes temporal coherence in observed or generated sequences from consistency in the underlying world state. Across tasks, representations, models, datasets, and benchmarks, we trace a shift in emphasis from clip-level recognition and perceptual fidelity toward persistent state, controllable evolution, physical and causal validity, and evaluation grounded in interaction and downstream decisions, and we distill the open challenges that follow.

ai_summary.problem: 视频基础模型与世界模型目标不同，但都涉及视频观测与不断演化世界之间的关系，领域缺乏一个统一视角来梳理相关研究。
ai_summary.method: 该综述将观测视频视为潜在时序世界的一个部分、有损且按时间排序的投影，围绕“阅读、写作、共享、交互”四种互补操作组织文献，并区分序列的时序连贯与底层世界状态的一致性。
ai_summary.result: 综述指出，研究重点正从片段级识别和感知保真，转向持久状态、可控演化、物理与因果有效性，以及基于交互和下游决策的评估，并总结了开放挑战。
ai_summary.novelty: 以世界建模作为统一视角，将视频理解与视频生成纳入“阅读—写作—共享—交互”框架，并强调底层世界状态一致性。
ai_summary.relevance: 为视频世界模型、多模态生成与理解、具身智能和Agent研究提供了系统性的概念框架与路线图。

papers.title: Ask About the Right Moment: Training-Free Object Identity Reasoning for Video-Language Models
papers.abstract: Many questions about a video concern one physical object. Where does the ball end up after the cups are shuffled? Which card is the queen? How often was the mug covered? Video-language models (Video-LMs) recognise such objects in single frames but do not keep them apart over time. On real shell-game videos, open models from 8B to 235B parameters, their thinking variants, a reinforcement-learned tool agent and three training-free tool agents all stay within ten points of chance. We separate semantic identity binding from temporal identity maintenance. An object's identity should be fixed at a moment when the evidence for it is visible, and carried afterwards by a tracker. \emph{Track, Then Bind} implements this principle without training. A promptable video tracker follows every candidate object and draws it with a track number. A frozen vision-language model answers a static question about the identifying evidence, which binds the target to a track. The answer is then derived from the tracked state in text, without asking the model to reinterpret the original video during read-out. A single configuration covers all benchmarks. With Qwen3-VL-32B it solves both VET-Bench tasks, where a fine-tuned trajectory model reaches 92\% and 90\% and the same VLM voting over 16 samples stays at 30--32\%. It answers 55.4\% of the hardest Perception Test cup games, where the best published model answers 41.5\%, and, using track-derived timelines, 48.6\% of TOC-Bench questions, against 37.1\% for the same model answering directly. Drawing the same tracks on the video and asking the question directly falls 12--19 points short of the agent on real cup games.

ai_summary.problem: 视频语言模型能识别单帧中的物体，却难以在时间维度上持续区分和追踪同一物体，导致在杯子游戏等物体身份推理任务上接近随机猜测。
ai_summary.method: 提出无需训练的“Track, Then Bind”框架：先用可提示视频跟踪器跟踪所有候选物体并标注轨迹编号，再用冻结的视觉语言模型回答关于身份识别证据的静态问题，将目标绑定到某条轨迹，最后基于文本化的跟踪状态推导答案。
ai_summary.result: 在VET-Bench两项任务、Perception Test最难杯子游戏和TOC-Bench上均显著优于直接问答及强基线；例如Qwen3-VL-32B在Perception Test最难杯子游戏上达到55.4%，超过已发表最佳41.5%。
ai_summary.novelty: 将语义身份绑定与时间身份维护解耦，并用“先跟踪、后绑定”的免训练智能体流程解决视频物体身份推理。
ai_summary.relevance: 为视频语言模型补足物体恒存与跨时身份追踪能力提供了简单有效的免训练范式，对多模态视频理解和具身智能中的对象级推理有直接意义。
ai_summary.org: 作者机构未提供

papers.title: Gate3DGen: A Pre-processing Model that Selectively Purifies Real-World Images for 3D Generation
papers.abstract: Single-image 3D generation has achieved high fidelity on curated benchmarks, yet degrades sharply on real-world images with uneven illumination, blur, and occlusions. Purifying such inputs requires deciding when to intervene and preserving the visual cues needed for 3D generation, while leaving clean inputs unchanged. We introduce Gate3DGen, a selective pre-processing model that gates image inputs to existing 3D generators without retraining them. A degradation-aware router bypasses inputs classified as clean and extracts features to guide purification of the remaining inputs. Conditioned on these features, a 3D-oriented one-step purifier purifies degraded inputs with spatial losses that encourage preservation of object identity, contours, and textural cues. To provide paired supervision, we construct a synthetic data engine that renders clean views of 3D assets and synthesises composite degradations. On the synthetic benchmark, the purifier improves image fidelity and downstream 3D geometry in only 2.3s on average, reducing TRELLIS.2 mesh distance by 61.5% relative to degraded inputs. VLM evaluation and human preferences on real photographs further support identity preservation and degradation correction. More demos and code are available at https://supra-3d.github.io/gate3dgen.

ai_summary.problem: 单图3D生成在理想基准上表现良好，但在光照不均、模糊和遮挡的真实图像上性能显著下降；需要一种能选择性净化退化输入、同时保留3D生成所需视觉线索且不改变干净输入的预处理方法。
ai_summary.method: 提出Gate3DGen，一种可插拔的选择性预处理模型：退化感知路由器判断输入是否干净，干净样本直接绕过，退化样本提取特征指导净化；3D导向的一步净化器结合空间损失保留物体身份、轮廓和纹理线索，并构建合成配对数据引擎提供监督。
ai_summary.result: 在合成基准上，净化器平均仅需2.3秒即可提升图像保真度和下游3D几何质量，相对退化输入将TRELLIS.2网格距离降低61.5%；VLM评估和真实照片上的人类偏好也支持身份保持与退化校正效果。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是面向真实图像3D生成的“选择性门控+退化感知路由+3D导向一步净化”的免重训练预处理框架。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作提升了现有单图3D生成器在真实退化场景下的鲁棒性和可用性，为图像到3D管线提供了一种轻量、即插即用的预处理思路。

papers.title: DiffDreamer: Coupling World Models with Differentiable Simulation for Agile Quadrotor Control
papers.abstract: Tasks such as quadrotor dynamic-gate racing require agents to anticipate external motion while maintaining precise high-frequency control. World-model-based reinforcement learning provides a natural solution by learning latent dynamics for future imagination, yet it often entangles environmental evolution and the robot's own dynamics in a single learned rollout, where model bias can affect policy optimization efficiency. We propose DiffDreamer, a differentiable reinforcement learning framework that tightly couples a learned world model with differentiable simulation for actor optimization. In one optimization step, the learned world model propagates latent states that capture external dynamics and history-dependent features, while the differentiable simulator propagates the robot's explicit physical state. We further decompose the actor objective into a critic-driven pathway for non-differentiable task rewards and a simulator-driven pathway for differentiable motion rewards. Experiments on aggressive tracking and dynamic-gate racing show that DiffDreamer improves training convergence over the model-free, model-based, and differentiable-RL baselines, and final performance over these baselines and classical planning and control methods. Additional experiments assess reward decomposition and the odometry-conditioned relative-state representation through ablations. We also provide proof-of-concept real-world flight experiments for validation.

ai_summary.problem: 四旋翼动态穿门竞速等任务要求智能体在保持高频精确控制的同时预测外部运动；现有基于世界模型的强化学习常将环境演化与机器人自身动力学纠缠在单次学习 rollout 中，模型偏差会影响策略优化效率。
ai_summary.method: 提出 DiffDreamer，将学习到的世界模型与可微分仿真紧耦合用于 actor 优化：世界模型传播捕捉外部动力学和历史依赖特征的隐状态，可微分仿真器传播机器人显式物理状态。并将 actor 目标分解为 critic 驱动的非可微分任务奖励路径和 simulator 驱动的可微分运动奖励路径。
ai_summary.result: 在激进跟踪和动态穿门竞速实验中，DiffDreamer 相比无模型、基于模型和可微分强化学习基线提升了训练收敛性，并在最终性能上优于这些基线及经典规划控制方法；消融实验验证了奖励分解和里程计条件相对状态表示，并提供了真实飞行概念验证。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是将世界模型与可微分仿真紧耦合，并分解 actor 目标以分别处理非可微分任务奖励和可微分运动奖励，用于敏捷四旋翼控制。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作展示了世界模型、可微分仿真与强化学习结合在具身智能和高速敏捷控制中的潜力，为复杂动态环境下的机器人策略学习提供了新思路。

papers.title: Progress Probes $P^2$: Lightweight Runtime Monitoring for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can perform diverse manipulation tasks directly from visual observations and natural language instructions, but they remain prone to mistakes and unpredictable failures. Deploying these policies without continuous human supervision will require robust runtime monitors that detect when the policy has gone off-course. Existing monitors use external foundation models, such as vision-language models (VLMs) to supervise the policy, introducing significant complexity and computational cost for monitoring at runtime. In this work, we investigate an alternate approach: \textit{can a VLA's own internal activations provide the information needed to monitor its execution?} Our method trains linear probes on policy activations from demonstrations to estimate progress, then flags executions that deviate from expected progress. In experiments with the open-source VLA $π_{0.5}$ and across simulated and real-world manipulation tasks, this approach is competitive with or outperforms VLM-based monitors in task failure detection, as well as methods which require failure data for training. These findings suggest that simple probes of VLA internals can be used to develop reliable runtime monitors, opening a path toward building policies that can act reliably and monitor their execution without external foundation models.

ai_summary.problem: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在运行时仍会犯错且失败不可预测，现有运行时监控依赖外部视觉语言模型（VLM），带来较高复杂度和计算成本。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出用 VLA 自身内部激活训练轻量线性探针，从示范数据中估计任务进度，并在执行偏离预期进度时触发失败告警。
ai_summary.result: 在开源 VLA 模型 π_{0.5} 的仿真与真实机器人操作任务中，该方法在失败检测上达到或超过基于 VLM 的监控器，以及需要失败数据训练的方法。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是利用 VLA 内部激活的简单线性探针实现轻量级运行时监控，无需外部基础模型或失败数据。
ai_summary.relevance: 表明 VLA 可通过自身内部表征实现可靠自监控，为无需外部大模型的高效安全部署提供新路径。

papers.title: Rethinking Sequence Compression with Test-time Regression
papers.abstract: Sequence compression is a fundamental operation and a critical information bottleneck in efficient language and multimodal models, and yet prevailing approaches based on pooling or learned projections remain underperforming. We revisit sequence compression through the lens of test-time regression: input tokens define a regression problem whose fitted coefficients form the compressed representation. Importantly, the regression problem is learned end-to-end via backpropagation, while its coefficients are computed efficiently in closed form during the forward pass. This leads to TTR-Compressor, a general alternative to conventional pooling and projection-based compression. We evaluate TTR-Compressor as the compressor for block-wise sparse attention and the visual token merger for multimodal large language models. On block-wise sparse attention, TTR-Compressor improves RULER performance over attention-based compressors by a large margin. For visual token merging, it consistently outperforms the standard MLP merger and matches its performance with 55.6% fewer visual tokens. These results establish test-time regression as an effective primitive for sequence compression in efficient language and multimodal models.

ai_summary.problem: 现有基于池化或学习投影的序列压缩方法性能不足，需要为高效语言模型和多模态模型寻找更强的信息瓶颈压缩方式。
ai_summary.method: 论文将序列压缩重新表述为测试时回归：输入 token 定义一个回归问题，拟合得到的系数作为压缩表示；回归问题端到端反向传播学习，而前向传播时以闭式解高效计算系数，形成 TTR-Compressor。
ai_summary.result: 在块稀疏注意力中，TTR-Compressor 在 RULER 上大幅优于基于注意力的压缩器；在视觉 token 合并中，它在少用 55.6% 视觉 token 的情况下匹配标准 MLP merger 的性能。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出将测试时回归作为序列压缩的通用原语，并实现端到端学习回归问题、前向闭式求解压缩系数的机制。
ai_summary.relevance: 为高效语言模型和多模态大模型提供了一种可替代池化/投影的通用序列压缩方法，有望缓解长序列和视觉 token 的信息瓶颈。

papers.title: LACToS: Local Anomaly Detection via Conditional Typicality of Superpixels
papers.abstract: Local anomaly detection is the task of identifying spatially confined anomalous or out-of-distribution (OOD) regions within an otherwise in-distribution (ID) image. Most existing methods are designed for a specific context, with a strong focus on industrial defect detection, where they achieve excellent performance on well-established benchmarks. However, we observe that these methods can exhibit significant performance drops in other contexts, especially when the inlier distribution is multimodal. To account for this inlier complexity, we propose LACToS, a principled local OOD detection method based on statistical typicality and made tractable through two innovations: (i) grouping pixels into superpixels and (ii) using a computationally efficient proxy to estimate typicality. We evaluate LACToS across three diverse applications spanning medical imaging, human faces, and X-ray security screening. LACToS performs more robustly than prior methods across these benchmarks. The code is released here: https://github.com/voilalab/LACToS.

ai_summary.problem: 局部异常检测旨在识别分布内图像中空间局限的异常或OOD区域；现有方法多面向工业缺陷检测，当分布内数据呈多模态时性能会显著下降。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出LACToS，一种基于统计典型性的局部OOD检测方法，通过将像素分组为超像素，并使用计算高效的代理来估计典型性，使方法可行。
ai_summary.result: 在医学影像、人脸和X射线安检三个应用场景中，LACToS相比已有方法表现更稳健。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新在于用超像素上的条件典型性建模局部OOD，并以高效代理实现可计算的统计典型性估计。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作推动局部异常检测从工业缺陷场景扩展到更一般的多模态分布内场景，对OOD检测和视觉异常检测具有参考价值。

papers.title: AgentVQA: A Unified Benchmark for Agentic Visual Understanding
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can perform a broad range of tasks across diverse settings, yet their performance in agentic contexts remains poorly understood. Although online evaluations in simulators and real-world environments are essential for measuring interactive agent performance, they are costly and challenging to scale. Complementary offline VQA benchmarks can enable faster and more reliable comparisons across agentic domains, yet existing benchmarks remain limited and fragmented. To address this gap, we introduce AgentVQA, an offline benchmark for evaluating VLMs on realistic agentic scenarios across five agent domains: Web Agents, Robotics, Egocentric Videos, Games, and Spatial Planning. We build AgentVQA by manually selecting 1000 challenging, real-world agent examples from 23 source datasets and adapting them for reliable offline evaluation. The resulting benchmark preserves realistic scenarios from interactive environments across diverse domains, and its model rankings track those from corresponding online evaluations. Across the 22 evaluated models, the best achieves only 58.5% accuracy. Our cross-domain analysis shows that errors are driven primarily by failures to ground and maintain accurate representations of the current and evolving visual state, including localizing relevant UI elements, interpreting motion, tracking state changes over time, and inferring 3D spatial relationships, rather than by task misinterpretation or downstream logical reasoning.

ai_summary.problem: 视觉语言模型在智能体（agentic）场景下的能力缺乏可扩展、可比的评测手段——在线仿真器评测成本高、难规模化，而现有离线VQA基准零散且覆盖有限。
ai_summary.method: 作者构建了 AgentVQA，从23个源数据集中人工挑选1000个具有挑战性的真实智能体样例，覆盖 Web Agents、机器人、第一视角视频、游戏、空间规划五个领域，并将其改造为可复现的离线VQA评测格式。
ai_summary.result: 评测的22个模型中最佳准确率仅58.5%；跨域分析表明错误主要源于无法定位并对齐当前及演化的视觉状态（如UI元素定位、运动理解、时序状态跟踪、3D空间关系推断），而非任务理解或逻辑推理失败。
ai_summary.novelty: 首个统一覆盖五大智能体领域的离线VQA基准，且其模型排名与对应在线交互评测保持一致。
ai_summary.relevance: 为智能体视觉理解提供了低成本、可规模化且与在线评测对齐的评测标准，并指明了视觉状态表征是当前VLM智能体能力的核心瓶颈。
ai_summary.org: 疑似 Meta / FAIR（根据作者 Zhuang Liu、Gabriel Sarch 等背景推断，摘要中未明确标注）

papers.title: MoG-VLM: Efficient Video Anomaly Detection through Motion-Guided Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong potential for video anomaly detection, but dense frame-level inference makes them impractical for real-time deployment. Existing acceleration commonly relies on uniform sampling, which ignores content dynamics and can either waste computation on static segments or miss localized anomalies. We propose MoG-VLM a motion-adaptive anomaly detection framework that leverages motion purely as a lightweight control signal to decide when VLM inference is necessary. To this end, we introduce Temporal Gradient Magnitude (TGM) which performs content-aware sampling to concentrate computation on informative regions while avoiding redundant processing. We further introduce a hierarchical dual-stream design in which dense multi-frame VLM reasoning is activated only around frames with elevated anomaly likelihood, via anchor-triggered context-window expansion with early termination. A fusion module then reconciles these instantaneous semantic cues with temporal action dynamics. Across four benchmarks, our method achieves 91.91%, 84.30%, 87.88%, and 78.96% AUC-ROC on XD-Violence, UCF-Crime, MSAD, and ShanghaiTech, respectively, establishing new state of the art on three benchmarks under the zero-shot, training-free setting. On XD-Violence, we improve over the previous best result by +0.57% while delivering a 1.31x inference speedup. These results demonstrate that content-aware allocation of VLM capacity, processing fewer frames more intelligently rather than all frames uniformly, is a more effective axis of progress than uniformly densifying VLM inference across frames. Code is available on GitHub: https://github.com/kdawoud91/MoG-VLM.

ai_summary.problem: 视频异常检测中，VLM逐帧密集推理成本高、难以实时部署，而现有均匀采样忽略内容动态，容易浪费算力或漏检局部异常。
ai_summary.method: 提出MoG-VLM，用运动信息作为轻量控制信号决定何时调用VLM；引入Temporal Gradient Magnitude进行内容感知采样，并设计分层双流结构，通过锚点触发上下文窗口扩展与早停，仅在异常可能性高的帧附近进行多帧VLM推理，最后融合瞬时语义线索与时序动作动态。
ai_summary.result: 在XD-Violence、UCF-Crime、MSAD和ShanghaiTech上分别达到91.91%、84.30%、87.88%和78.96% AUC-ROC，在零样本、免训练设置下于三个基准取得新SOTA；XD-Violence上较此前最佳提升0.57%并实现1.31倍推理加速。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是用运动作为轻量路由信号，自适应分配VLM计算资源，而非对所有帧均匀密集推理。
ai_summary.relevance: 为视频异常检测提供更高效的VLM推理范式，说明内容感知地“少帧但智能处理”比均匀增密更具进展价值。

papers.title: Skeleton-Grounded Latent Action Model for Robot World Models
papers.abstract: Robot world models simulate how environments evolve in response to robot actions. Latent action models enable learning dynamics from videos by encoding visual transitions as proxy actions. However, reconstruction-driven latent actions mix robot motion with object responses and other scene changes, complicating their correspondence with robot controls. We propose SkeLAM, a skeleton-guided latent action model for controllable robot world modeling. SkeLAM decomposes latent actions into a kinematic component grounded by robot skeleton supervision and a residual component retaining complementary visual dynamics. Cross-modal swap reconstruction encourages RGB-derived and skeleton-derived kinematic representations to be interchangeable during video reconstruction. The world model incorporates both components through separate conditioning pathways, while branch dropout reduces its dependence on future-derived residual information. A lightweight adapter maps robot actions to the kinematic space, and subsequent world-model fine-tuning adapts generation to these predicted conditions. At inference, the model generates future observations from the current observation and robot actions. On DROID, SkeLAM reduces end-effector ADE by 19.5% and LPIPS by 11.1% compared with DreamDojo. Motion probing supports kinematic specialization, while qualitative results demonstrate zero-shot human-to-robot motion transfer in generated rollouts. Policy evaluation shows agreement between predicted success rates and those measured in real robot executions.

ai_summary.problem: 现有由重建驱动的隐动作模型（latent action model）会把机器人自身运动与物体响应、场景变化混在一起，导致隐动作难以与真实机器人控制信号对应，从而限制机器人世界模型的可控性。
ai_summary.method: 提出 SkeLAM：用机器人骨架监督把隐动作分解为『运动学分量』（kinematic）和保留其余视觉动态的『残差分量』，并通过跨模态交换重建（cross-modal swap reconstruction）迫使 RGB 与骨架两条路径学到的运动学表示可互换；世界模型用两条独立条件通路注入这两个分量，配合 branch dropout 降低对含未来信息的残差项的依赖，再用轻量 adapter 把真实机器人动作映射到运动学空间并微调生成。
ai_summary.result: 在 DROID 数据集上，相比 DreamDojo 将末端执行器 ADE 降低 19.5%、LPIPS 降低 11.1%；运动探测（motion probing）验证了运动学分量的专一性，定性结果显示生成 rollout 中具备零样本人到机器人动作迁移能力，策略评估中预测成功率与真机执行结果一致。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是用骨架监督对隐动作做『运动学/残差』解耦，并以跨模态交换重建把 RGB 隐动作与骨架运动学表示对齐，使世界模型的条件输入更贴近真实控制信号。
ai_summary.relevance: 为视频驱动的机器人世界模型提供了更可控、可解释的动作表征方案，有助于缩小『视频学动力学』与『真实机器人控制』之间的鸿沟，对具身智能与世界模型方向有直接参考价值。
ai_summary.org: 提供的作者信息中未给出机构（affiliations 为空）；作者包括 Qi Lv、Jiayi Lin、Yuxin Jiang、Jianzong Wang、Xiang Deng，无法可靠确认所属单位。

papers.title: Drift Says When, Budget Says How Much: Rate-Controlled KV Re-selection for Long-Form Multimodal Generation
papers.abstract: KV cache compression for multimodal LLMs usually selects the visual tokens to keep once, at prefill, and reuses that selection for the whole generation. We show that this one-shot selection is severely limited on long-form generation: on detailed image description, even an oracle that selects with the attention of the uncompressed answer reaches only 0.44-0.52 ROUGE-L agreement with the uncompressed output, because the evidence the model reads moves as the description unfolds. Re-selecting whenever attention drifts out of the kept set is the natural remedy, but we find that a fixed drift threshold fails systematically: drift magnitudes are not comparable across samples, so low-drift samples are almost never refreshed although they benefit the most. We propose Rate-Controlled Refresh (RCR), which lets drift decide when and where to re-select while a per-sample controller regulates how often, combined with a low-rank drift detector, candidate-restricted re-selection, and a decision that stays on the GPU. With one setting for all models and tasks, RCR outperforms the per-step retrieval method InfiniGen by 1.6-3.8 ROUGE-L points on five of six model-task settings with no significant difference on the sixth, while staying within 1.7 points of exact per-step re-selection, with comparable estimated data movement per step and a 4x smaller GPU-resident detector. On DetailCaps, drift-chosen timing beats random timing at the same refresh rate and periodic timing even at a higher rate, by 2.0-5.0 points. On pre-registered video description, where drift is homogeneous across samples, RCR is on par with InfiniGen on Qwen2-VL and exceeds it on Qwen3-VL but no longer beats a fixed threshold at the nearest tested rates, consistent with the diagnosis; object-level evaluation shows that RCR achieves higher object F1 against the uncompressed output than InfiniGen on two of three models.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态大模型在长文本生成时，KV cache 压缩通常只在 prefill 阶段一次性选定要保留的视觉 token，但生成过程中模型依赖的证据会随描述推进而漂移，导致一次性选择与未压缩输出的一致性很差。
ai_summary.method: 提出速率控制的刷新机制 RCR：由注意力漂移决定何时、在哪些位置重新选择视觉 token，同时用一个逐样本控制器调节刷新频率，避免固定漂移阈值在不同样本间不可比的问题；并配合低秩漂移检测器、候选受限的重选策略以及全程留在 GPU 上的决策流程。
ai_summary.result: 在六个模型-任务设置中的五个上，RCR 比逐步检索方法 InfiniGen 高 1.6–3.8 ROUGE-L，与精确逐步重选相差不超过 1.7 分，检测器显存占用小 4 倍；在 DetailCaps 上，漂移驱动的时机优于同频率随机刷新和更高频率的周期刷新 2.0–5.0 分。
ai_summary.novelty: 揭示了长文本生成中视觉证据随生成漂移、一次性 KV 选择失效的问题，并用“漂移决定何时、控制器决定多频繁”的解耦设计替代固定阈值。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态长文本生成中的 KV cache 压缩与视觉 token 保留提供了更自适应的方案，有助于降低长输出场景的推理开销。
ai_summary.org: 未提供作者机构信息

papers.title: FastHarness: Experience-Driven Review Scheduling for Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract: Agentic robot systems combine language-model reasoning with robot policies to monitor execution and recover from failures. However, reviewing every action chunk incurs substantial overhead, even in familiar situations. We introduce FastHarness, an experience-driven execution harness that adaptively schedules GPT-6 Astra supervision of a π0.5 policy. A fast path uses stage memory and reviewed outcomes to reduce review frequency as experience accumulates, while a complementary recovery path focuses supervision on correcting errors. Once recovery is verified, routine execution resumes, with failure experience retained to guide future interventions. The policy remains frozen and generates fresh actions from current observations. Across four simulated manipulation tasks, reviewer token use decreases by an average of 57.2% per task from the first evaluated episode to the mean of the final five episodes. Mean episode time decreases from 85.5 to 52.0 minutes over the same interval. On the same tasks, mean success increases from 80% for GPT-as-Policy (π0.5 + GPT-6 Astra) to 97.19% with FastHarness. These results highlight adaptive supervision as a practical route to more efficient agentic robotics without additional model training.

ai_summary.problem: 在语言模型驱动的机器人智能体系统中，逐步审查每个动作块会带来巨大的推理开销，即使是在已经熟悉的场景中也是如此，缺乏能够根据经验自适应调整监督频率的机制。
ai_summary.method: 提出 FastHarness，一个由经验驱动的执行监控框架，用于自适应地调度 GPT-6 Astra 对冻结的 π0.5 策略进行监督：快速路径利用阶段记忆与已审查结果，随着经验积累降低审查频率；恢复路径在检测到错误时集中进行纠错监督，经验证后恢复正常执行，并保留失败经验以指导后续干预。
ai_summary.result: 在四个仿真操作任务上，审查 token 消耗从首个评估回合到末五回合均值平均下降 57.2%，平均单回合耗时从 85.5 分钟降至 52.0 分钟；平均成功率从 GPT-as-Policy 的 80% 提升至 97.19%。
ai_summary.novelty: 将“经验驱动的自适应监督调度”引入 VLA 策略执行流程，在无需额外模型训练、策略保持冻结的前提下，同时降低审查成本并提升任务成功率。
ai_summary.relevance: 为具身智能与智能体机器人提供了一条通过自适应监控与经验复用降低大模型推理开销、提升可靠性的实用路径，对构建高效可部署的机器人智能体系统具有参考价值。
ai_summary.org: 论文未提供作者所属机构信息

papers.title: FocusVLA: Future-Intent Guided Dynamic View Routing for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have become an important paradigm for robotic manipulation by unifying visual perception, language understanding, and action generation. Since reliable manipulation requires sufficient observation of objects, end-effectors, and their spatial relationships, multi-view inputs are widely used to provide complementary spatial information. However, our experiments show that existing VLA models do not fully exploit such multi-view complementarity. The policy tends to persistently rely on the wrist view, lacking the ability to dynamically adjust global-local view dependency across manipulation stages, which limits stage adaptability and robustness. To address this issue, we propose FocusVLA, a stage-aware multi-view routing framework. FocusVLA predicts future interaction intent from historical actions and uses it to guide dynamic view routing during action generation. By adaptively coordinating global and local observations across different task stages, FocusVLA improves multi-view utilization. On RoboTwin 2.0, FocusVLA improves the average success rate over the strongest baseline $π_{0.5}$ by 10.10 pp. In real-world evaluation, FocusVLA improves the success rate from 71.7\% to 85.0\%, achieving a 13.3\% gain over $π_{0.5}$. Moreover, the intent prediction and dynamic routing modules of FocusVLA can be integrated into existing VLA frameworks without modifying their core architectures.

ai_summary.problem: 现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型未能充分利用多视角输入的互补性，策略倾向于持续依赖腕部视角，缺乏在不同操作阶段动态调整全局与局部视角依赖的能力，限制了阶段适应性和鲁棒性。
ai_summary.method: 作者提出 FocusVLA，一种阶段感知的多视角路由框架。它从历史动作中预测未来交互意图，并用该意图在动作生成过程中引导动态视角路由，从而在不同任务阶段自适应协调全局与局部观测，提高多视角利用率。
ai_summary.result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0 上，FocusVLA 相比最强基线 π_{0.5} 平均成功率提升 10.10 个百分点；真实世界评估中成功率从 71.7% 提升到 85.0%，相对 π_{0.5} 提升 13.3%。其意图预测和动态路由模块可在不修改核心架构的情况下集成到现有 VLA 框架中。
ai_summary.novelty: 创新点在于利用未来交互意图引导 VLA 模型进行阶段感知的动态全局-局部视角路由，以提升多视角利用效率和操作鲁棒性。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作为机器人操作中的多视角 VLA 策略提供了可插拔的动态视角选择机制，有助于提升复杂任务中的阶段适应性和真实环境鲁棒性。

papers.title: GelSlim 5.0: Unifying Vision and Touch with a Single Fingertip Camera
papers.abstract: Vision and touch provide complementary cues for object pose and local contact geometry, but external cameras are often occluded at the contact site. We present GelSlim 5.0, a fingertip sensor that acquires visual and tactile observations with one fixed camera and a continuous UV-responsive contact layer. By switching illumination, the camera sequentially acquires through-membrane visual images and contact-sensitive tactile images from a shared viewpoint, avoiding inter-camera extrinsic calibration. To combine these observations, we introduce VisTacFusion, a multimodal transformer with separate prediction paths for planar object pose and contact geometry. Asymmetric bottleneck fusion incorporates visual context while preserving tactile spatial features for depth and surface-normal estimation. Modality dropout enables inference with paired inputs or either modality alone. On real validation data from 12 known objects, paired inputs reduce depth MSE, angular error, and translation $L_1$ by 61.2%, 72.3%, and 61.3%, respectively, relative to tactile-only inference with the same model. Relative to visual-only inference, the corresponding reductions are 93.7%, 6.1%, and 8.6%.

ai_summary.problem: 机器人指尖传感中，外部相机在接触点常被遮挡，且视觉与触觉来自不同相机时存在外参标定问题；论文希望用单一传感器同时获取共享视角的视觉与触觉信息，并融合用于物体位姿和接触几何估计。
ai_summary.method: 提出 GelSlim 5.0 指尖传感器：使用单个固定相机和连续紫外响应接触层，通过切换照明依次采集透过膜的视觉图像与接触敏感触觉图像，避免多相机外参标定。提出 VisTacFusion 多模态 Transformer，分别预测平面物体位姿和接触几何，采用非对称瓶颈融合保留触觉空间特征，并用模态 dropout 支持成对或单模态推理。
ai_summary.result: 在12个已知物体的真实验证数据上，成对输入相比同模型仅触觉推理，将深度 MSE、角度误差和平移 L1 分别降低 61.2%、72.3%、61.3%；相比仅视觉推理分别降低 93.7%、6.1%、8.6%。
ai_summary.novelty: 用单相机通过照明切换在同一视角下统一视觉与触觉采集，并设计非对称瓶颈融合的多模态 Transformer 来联合估计位姿与接触几何。
ai_summary.relevance: 为具身智能和机器人操作提供更紧凑、免外参标定的视触觉融合传感与学习方案，有助于提升接触丰富任务中的多模态感知能力。
ai_summary.org: 密歇根大学（University of Michigan，依据作者推断）

papers.title: CRANE: Post-Hoc Counterfactual Retrieval for Multimodal Classifiers
papers.abstract: Counterfactual explanation methods have been introduced for unimodal settings, with dedicated frameworks for tabular, timeseries, text, and image data, yet no post-hoc method has been designed for classifiers that learn from multimodal inputs. Existing explainability methods for multimodal classifiers apply modality-specific attribution independently to each input, which fails to yield coherent explanations and does not transfer to arbitrary pre-trained multimodal architectures. To address these shortcomings, we present CRANE (Counterfactual Retrieval via Agnostic Nearest-neighbour Explanations), the first post-hoc, model-agnostic framework for nearest-neighbour multimodal counterfactual generation that retrieves real training examples from the target class as candidate explanations, ensuring plausibility by construction. Across four heterogeneous datasets and three fusion strategies, we show that Multimodal Consensus Retrieval (MC-R), which intersects per-modality neighbour sets to identify instances jointly close to the query in every modality, emerges as the strongest multimodal strategy, achieving the best or joint-best outcome on three of four datasets while grounding every explanation in the joint training distribution. Unimodal strategies remain competitive when a single modality dominates the decision boundary.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态分类器缺乏专门的事后反事实解释方法；现有方法通常对各模态独立做归因，难以产生连贯解释，也不能通用到任意预训练多模态架构。
ai_summary.method: 提出 CRANE，一个事后、模型无关的多模态最近邻反事实生成框架，从目标类中检索真实训练样本作为候选解释以保证合理性；其中 Multimodal Consensus Retrieval (MC-R) 通过交集各模态的邻居集合，找出在每个模态上都接近查询的样本。
ai_summary.result: 在四个异构数据集和三种融合策略上，MC-R 在其中三个数据集上取得最佳或并列最佳表现，并且每个解释都基于联合训练分布；当单一模态主导决策边界时，单模态策略仍具竞争力。
ai_summary.novelty: 首个事后、模型无关的多模态最近邻反事实解释框架，并提出通过多模态共识检索生成联合分布中的真实反事实样本。
ai_summary.relevance: 有助于提升多模态分类器的可解释性与可信度，为模型调试、责任归因和多模态决策理解提供实用工具。
ai_summary.org: 斯德哥尔摩大学（Stockholm University）

papers.title: CellTrack-Bench: Microscopic Cell Tracking Benchmark for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Large language models have shown outstanding performance on text-first tasks such as coding, math, and writing. Recent efforts are shifting models' training to include scientific problems that often live in highly specialized domains beyond text, such as protein structure and biological images. However, in these scenarios, their general-purpose accuracy compared with specialized algorithms remains in question. One such domain is cell tracking, which requires spatiotemporal awareness of cell dynamics. To evaluate this, we created a new benchmark, CellTrack-Bench, which assesses Vision-Language Models' (VLMs) cell-tracking-related performance against specialized trackers. The full benchmark draws from 15 standard cell-tracking datasets across four imaging modalities and comprises 1,537 problems corresponding to 9,041 cell-linking decisions. We selected a hard subset requiring greater reasoning effort by identifying failures shared across distinct algorithmic trackers. With this proposed dataset, we: (i) evaluated different environment harnesses for VLMs; (ii) benchmarked 9 frontier closed-source models and 13 open-weight models; and (iii) provided a detailed analysis of their failure modes. Code, the stored model outputs, and a pipeline that regenerates the benchmark from the source datasets are available at https://github.com/royerlab/celltrack-bench.

ai_summary.problem: 通用视觉语言模型（VLM）在细胞追踪这类需要时空推理的高度专业化生物成像任务上，相比专用追踪算法究竟能否胜任、在哪些环节失败，目前缺乏系统评测手段。
ai_summary.method: 作者构建了 CellTrack-Bench 基准，整合 4 种成像模态、15 个标准细胞追踪数据集，共 1,537 道题、对应 9,041 次细胞链接判定；并通过挖掘多个不同算法追踪器共同失败的案例，筛出需要更强推理的困难子集。随后系统比较了不同 VLM 环境脚手架，评测了 9 个闭源前沿模型与 13 个开放权重模型，并对失败模式做了细致归类分析。
ai_summary.result: 论文给出了 VLM 在细胞追踪任务上相对专用追踪器的能力画像，揭示了其在时空一致性、细胞链接决策等方面的典型失败模式，并开源了基准、模型输出与可复现的数据再生成流水线。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次为细胞追踪这一专业时空任务建立面向 VLM 的大规模多模态基准，并用“多算法共同失败”策略构造高推理难度的评测子集。
ai_summary.relevance: 为评估通用大模型在科学发现与生物图像分析中的真实能力边界提供了标准化标尺，推动 VLM 向具备时空推理的科学智能方向发展。
ai_summary.org: Royer Lab（Loïc A. Royer 课题组，疑似 Chan Zuckerberg Biohub）

papers.title: DuoCook: An Overcooked-Inspired Benchmark for Visual Planning and Coordination
papers.abstract: Coordinating two players in a cooking task requires a vision-language agent to track changing scene states, sequence recipe steps, and allocate shared resources under a time budget. We introduce an Overcooked-inspired benchmark for evaluating these capabilities in Unreal Engine environments constructed using coding agents. A single vision-language model controls both players from top-down visual observations, selecting high-level actions while the engine executes navigation. The benchmark contains 20 maps in five categories. These categories support evaluation of centralized coordination under equipment contention, changing terrain, and handoff dependencies. A prop legend and pot ingredient-count indicators provide explicit visual cues, while grid-based destinations support spatial grounding. The evaluation compares four VLMs on all 20 maps, measuring task score, order completion, delivery precision, action acceptance rate, and model API expenditure. A memory ablation on the same 20 maps examines the effect of a shared, self-authored notebook while retaining six-response action history in both conditions. The strongest evaluated model, \texttt{gpt-6-astra}, achieves 26.2\% mean order completion. Notebook memory has mixed score effects across models, with positive mean differences for Claude and Qwen and negative differences for GPT and Gemini.

ai_summary.problem: 论文要解决的是如何系统评估视觉语言模型在多玩家烹饪协作任务中的视觉规划、步骤排序、资源分配与记忆能力。
ai_summary.method: 作者用编码智能体在 Unreal Engine 中构建了 20 张、5 类 Overcooked 风格地图，由单个 VLM 从俯视视觉观测同时控制两个玩家并输出高层动作，引擎负责导航执行。评测比较 4 个 VLM 的任务得分、订单完成率、交付精度、动作接受率和 API 开销，并进行共享笔记本记忆消融实验。
ai_summary.result: 最强模型 gpt-6-astra 平均订单完成率为 26.2%，说明任务仍具挑战性；共享自写笔记本记忆对不同模型效果不一，Claude 和 Qwen 平均提升，GPT 和 Gemini 平均下降。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出了基于 Unreal Engine、由单个 VLM 集中控制双玩家的 Overcooked 风格视觉规划与协调基准，并引入共享记忆消融评估。
ai_summary.relevance: 为 VLM/Agent 在视觉环境中的多步规划、双智能体协调、资源竞争和外部记忆使用提供了可复现评测平台。

papers.title: A Task-Centric Survey of Long-Document Visual Question Answering: Taxonomy, Evolution, and Future Directions
papers.abstract: Visual document understanding is essential for acquiring knowledge from visually rich documents and is attracting growing research interest. Existing surveys emphasize architectures or technical approaches, with limited attention to how task bottlenecks shape technical choices and research priorities. We present a task-centric survey that decomposes long-document visual question answering (VQA) into four components: document parsing, evidence organization and retrieval, generator organization and learning, and evaluation. For each, we develop a fine-grained taxonomy and trace motivations, technical responses, and cross-component connections. We focus on explicit retrieval while covering direct reading. Our temporal analysis traces expanding priorities from multimodal content understanding to sufficient, high-fidelity evidence acquisition and sustained evidence management. We outline future directions in evidence sufficiency, verifiable and correctable understanding, and budget-aware coordination, with an outlook on continual document understanding.

ai_summary.problem: 现有长文档视觉问答综述多聚焦模型架构或技术路线，较少从任务瓶颈角度解释技术选择与研究优先级。本文旨在提供任务中心的长文档视觉问答综述，梳理其关键组成与发展脉络。
ai_summary.method: 将长文档视觉问答拆解为文档解析、证据组织与检索、生成器组织与学习、评估四个部分，并为每部分建立细粒度分类体系，追踪动机、技术响应及跨组件联系。综述以显式检索为重点，同时涵盖直接阅读路线，并进行时间维度的演化分析。
ai_summary.result: 论文梳理出研究重点从多模态内容理解逐步扩展到充分、高保真证据获取与持续证据管理，并提出证据充分性、可验证与可纠正理解、预算感知协调等未来方向，展望持续文档理解。
ai_summary.novelty: 以任务瓶颈和跨组件联系为中心组织长文档视觉问答综述，并给出细粒度分类与时间演化视角。
ai_summary.relevance: 有助于AI研究者系统理解长文档视觉文档理解与VQA的关键瓶颈、技术路线和未来研究机会。

papers.title: Metric Conformal Prediction via the Conditional Expected Local Radius
papers.abstract: We introduce the conditional expected local radius (CELR) and develop a new conformal prediction method for non-Euclidean responses in general metric spaces. CELR measures local conditional probability concentration, allowing prediction sets to accommodate heterogeneity and multimodality without requiring densities or a vector space structure. Its conditional distribution yields a nonconformity score that is comparable across covariate values and avoids costly transport comparisons between distance profiles. We further adapt a metric distributional random forest that handles multivariate covariates and nonlinear interactions, while a single forest fit supplies all score components, reducing computation by eliminating repeated local fitting. We establish uniform consistency of the estimators and asymptotic conditional validity under suitable regularity conditions, together with finite-sample marginal coverage under exchangeability. Numerical studies demonstrate effective uncertainty quantification across different metric spaces and substantial computational savings over the conditional profile score method.

ai_summary.problem: 该论文旨在解决一般度量空间中非欧几里得响应的共形预测问题，使预测集能够适应异质性和多峰性，同时不依赖概率密度或向量空间结构。
ai_summary.method: 作者提出条件期望局部半径（CELR）来度量局部条件概率集中度，并由此构造在不同协变量取值间可比较的非一致性分数；同时适配度量分布随机森林处理多变量协变量和非线性交互，且一次森林拟合即可提供全部分数组件。
ai_summary.result: 论文证明了估计量的一致性和渐近条件有效性，并在可交换性下给出有限样本边际覆盖保证；数值研究表明该方法能在不同度量空间中有效量化不确定性，并显著减少相比条件 profile score 方法的计算量。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是提出基于 CELR 的共形非一致性分数，在一般度量空间中避免密度估计和昂贵的距离分布传输比较。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作为复杂非欧数据和多模态响应提供了更实用的不确定性量化工具，对可靠机器学习和AI中的置信预测具有方法学意义。

key_lab_papers.title: AgentVQA: A Unified Benchmark for Agentic Visual Understanding
key_lab_papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can perform a broad range of tasks across diverse settings, yet their performance in agentic contexts remains poorly understood. Although online evaluations in simulators and real-world environments are essential for measuring interactive agent performance, they are costly and challenging to scale. Complementary offline VQA benchmarks can enable faster and more reliable comparisons across agentic domains, yet existing benchmarks remain limited and fragmented. To address this gap, we introduce AgentVQA, an offline benchmark for evaluating VLMs on realistic agentic scenarios across five agent domains: Web Agents, Robotics, Egocentric Videos, Games, and Spatial Planning. We build AgentVQA by manually selecting 1000 challenging, real-world agent examples from 23 source datasets and adapting them for reliable offline evaluation. The resulting benchmark preserves realistic scenarios from interactive environments across diverse domains, and its model rankings track those from corresponding online evaluations. Across the 22 evaluated models, the best achieves only 58.5% accuracy. Our cross-domain analysis shows that errors are driven primarily by failures to ground and maintain accurate representations of the current and evolving visual state, including localizing relevant UI elements, interpreting motion, tracking state changes over time, and inferring 3D spatial relationships, rather than by task misinterpretation or downstream logical reasoning.

ai_summary.problem: 视觉语言模型在智能体（agentic）场景下的能力缺乏可扩展、可比的评测手段——在线仿真器评测成本高、难规模化，而现有离线VQA基准零散且覆盖有限。
ai_summary.method: 作者构建了 AgentVQA，从23个源数据集中人工挑选1000个具有挑战性的真实智能体样例，覆盖 Web Agents、机器人、第一视角视频、游戏、空间规划五个领域，并将其改造为可复现的离线VQA评测格式。
ai_summary.result: 评测的22个模型中最佳准确率仅58.5%；跨域分析表明错误主要源于无法定位并对齐当前及演化的视觉状态（如UI元素定位、运动理解、时序状态跟踪、3D空间关系推断），而非任务理解或逻辑推理失败。
ai_summary.novelty: 首个统一覆盖五大智能体领域的离线VQA基准，且其模型排名与对应在线交互评测保持一致。
ai_summary.relevance: 为智能体视觉理解提供了低成本、可规模化且与在线评测对齐的评测标准，并指明了视觉状态表征是当前VLM智能体能力的核心瓶颈。
ai_summary.org: 疑似 Meta / FAIR（根据作者 Zhuang Liu、Gabriel Sarch 等背景推断，摘要中未明确标注）

key_lab_papers.title: DuoCook: An Overcooked-Inspired Benchmark for Visual Planning and Coordination
key_lab_papers.abstract: Coordinating two players in a cooking task requires a vision-language agent to track changing scene states, sequence recipe steps, and allocate shared resources under a time budget. We introduce an Overcooked-inspired benchmark for evaluating these capabilities in Unreal Engine environments constructed using coding agents. A single vision-language model controls both players from top-down visual observations, selecting high-level actions while the engine executes navigation. The benchmark contains 20 maps in five categories. These categories support evaluation of centralized coordination under equipment contention, changing terrain, and handoff dependencies. A prop legend and pot ingredient-count indicators provide explicit visual cues, while grid-based destinations support spatial grounding. The evaluation compares four VLMs on all 20 maps, measuring task score, order completion, delivery precision, action acceptance rate, and model API expenditure. A memory ablation on the same 20 maps examines the effect of a shared, self-authored notebook while retaining six-response action history in both conditions. The strongest evaluated model, \texttt{gpt-6-astra}, achieves 26.2\% mean order completion. Notebook memory has mixed score effects across models, with positive mean differences for Claude and Qwen and negative differences for GPT and Gemini.

daily_insight.hot_topics: 今日研究热点高度集中在多模态与具身智能的交叉领域：VLA策略的运行时监控、动态视角路由与经验驱动调度成为提升具身策略鲁棒性的三条并行路径；世界模型则被用作统一视频理解与生成、连接可微分仿真与隐动作表征的底层框架。此外，视频/长文档场景下的KV缓存重选与序列压缩，以及面向Agent与专业领域（细胞追踪、视觉规划）的新基准密集出现，显示评测体系正在从通用感知转向交互与推理难度。
daily_insight.lab_overlap: Anthropic与Google在DuoCook基准上直接合作，方向为多模态大模型驱动的视觉规划与多智能体协调，方法上采用单个VLM集中控制双玩家并引入共享记忆消融，属于同一篇论文的共同署名而非竞争性重复工作。Meta的AgentVQA聚焦智能体视觉理解的统一离线评测，与DuoCook在'多模态+Agent'大方向上有交集，但前者偏跨领域VQA能力度量，后者偏具身协作规划，形成评测层面的互补而非方法对抗。整体看，大厂今日在多模态Agent评测上呈现'共建基准'的态势，竞争焦点在谁能定义被广泛采用的评测标准。
daily_insight.signals: 值得关注的信号有三：一是VLA运行时治理成为独立子方向，Progress Probes与FastHarness均在冻结策略上做轻量探针或经验调度，暗示具身部署正从'训得更好'转向'跑得更稳更省'；二是世界模型开始与可微分仿真、骨架运动学等物理先验紧耦合，路线从纯生成转向可控制、可对齐；三是评测基准密集发布（AgentVQA、DuoCook、CellTrack-Bench），且大厂联合署名，基准共建可能成为新一轮话语权争夺点。
